hardware.variant: CIX P1 CD8180; stock UEFI V1.4; no RTC backup battery; root on microSD

inputs.name: NetBSD 11.1 (EMBER64) #0 ELF with the CIX UART2 console gate, built by the SDK kernel profile before a rebase that changed one EMBER64 comment (BUILDINFO 9ec520426468ab237c99a047b21452c8a6a15f40)
gzip of that kernel on the EFI system partition

scenario: Boot the kernel three times at the loader prompt with the existing FFS root: Support SPCR enabled without 'acpi cix-spcr'; Support SPCR enabled with 'acpi cix-spcr'; Support SPCR disabled in UEFI setup. Read dmesg over SSH after each boot. Then enable Support SPCR again.
expected: In all three boots, the kernel selects DEBUG UART2 as console and reaches multi-user operation.
observed: Each boot printed 'CIX UART2 console: selected (0)' and 'plcom2: console', mounted the FFS root, completed rc and accepted SSH over Ethernet. kern.buildinfo matched the input. dmesg had no panic or uvm_fault, and sbsawdt0 was armed. With Support SPCR disabled, the loader printed 'CIX SPCR: SPCR or DBG2 is missing' and acpidump listed no SPCR. Restore AC Power Loss stayed 'Power On'. Two early 'WARNING: no console device' lines also appear with the earlier trial kernel.
limits: Three warm boots on one board with UEFI V1.4. Board revision was not recorded.
UEFI V1.5 and a boot after input power removal were not tested with this kernel.
The cixvpu GCLK query errors of the general kernel remain.
